method: Native campaign, balanced points, targeted equipment/material and coin farming after defeats; timed free camp HP recovery, paid mana/potions/tracking, earned drops/chests/contracts only. Success at final boss victory; quit only after 11 deaths while level 100 with all six equipped slots legendary.
